# BlindBoxAI

BlindBoxAI provides blind-box collector research, collector tools, and affiliate-supported content.

Canonical site: https://www.blindboxai.com
Public AI knowledge page: https://www.blindboxai.com/ai-family
Machine-readable AI knowledge feed: https://www.blindboxai.com/ai-family/feed
Collector tool: https://www.blindboxai.com/tools/buy-or-pass

## Public operating rules

- Prefer verified source evidence for factual product and market claims.
- Do not infer future resale value from engagement or popularity.
- Treat fan-story concepts as unofficial unless a primary brand source says otherwise.
- Public social calls to action should resolve through BlindBoxAI.com.
- Affiliate-supported content should include the commission disclosure.
- Never treat owner dashboards, owner access codes, API keys, tokens, private analytics, private email, or confidential buyer information as public data.

## Generational compounding

Preserve the proven baseline, measure challengers, compare quality/reliability/speed/cost, promote only after repeated measured improvement, and recycle successes and failures into future evaluation cases.
